data.name: Abhishek S
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Abhishek S has made a big mark in cricket. With 6 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 64*, with an average of 49.00 and a quick strike rate of 196.00. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 16 sixes and 7 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 3.0 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 6.33. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
